title: Private credentials
boundary: Read the saved batch’s source metadata, then explicitly select the device holding its credentials. Private values are transferred separately and never displayed here. Preparing credentials does not save the batch or change the default model.
update_required: Update this Gateway and target to use private credential migration.
request_failed: The operation was not confirmed. Check the original receipt before continuing.
no_sources: This batch has no received sources eligible for private credential migration.
choose_device: Explicitly choose the device that holds the original credentials. A device label does not verify its source identity.
no_candidates: No credential candidates are available for this original source and plan.
consent_keys: Authorize transfer of the selected API keys
consent_mcp: Authorize transfer of the selected MCP private fields
recovery_boundary: These local records only locate original offers. Reading them does not retransfer credentials or select a source device.
unknown: The outcome is unknown. No transfer was automatically repeated.
cancel_boundary: Cancellation does not delete received data or undo saved credentials. Saved outputs use the original batch’s Undo.
include_offer: Include this received offer in credential preparation
same_request: One preparation includes up to 16 offers from the same original transfer. Other transfers are not included. Conflicting or incomplete credentials remain disabled until resolved.
prepare: Confirm preparation for the saved batch
prepare_unknown: The preparation reply was not confirmed. Read the original preparation intent before any explicit retry; do not create another offer.
candidate_unavailable: This candidate cannot be transferred to the saved plan.
phase_received: Received on target; batch not yet saved
phase_cancelling: Cancellation requested; worker has not stopped
preparation_not_started: No preparation has started for this job. Earlier transfers may still have executed.
preparation_prepared: The original offer set was prepared.
preparation_unknown: The original preparation cannot be confirmed. Do not replay it.
preparation_boundary: Preparation is not publication. This receipt does not confirm live credentials or stopped workers. Closing this view does not roll back received data. Reconcile the original intent before ordinary batch Undo.
preparation_problem: Read the original preparation intent first. Closing does not undo it; reconcile it explicitly before using ordinary batch Undo.
